name: bilingual-paper-editor
description: Bilingual Paper Workbench: original-format LaTeX PDFs, protected translations and reviews, with model execution in your existing Codex Desktop chat.

interface.shortDescription: Read and translate papers with your existing Codex Desktop chat.
interface.longDescription: Bilingual Paper Workbench reuses one local three-column paper window. Import LaTeX source and review files, keep the original PDF layout, and edit translations with protected equations and citations. Explicit translation and review requests run in the verified Desktop chat that opened the plugin, retaining its history, model and project directory without a second model writer. Translate the whole paper or chosen paragraph ranges with saved progress, cancellation and explicit resume. Read suggested wording, translations and reasons beside each paragraph. Source revisions and undo require isolated compilation and confirmation. English is the default interface; 46 languages are selectable.
defaultPrompt: For source or review files I explicitly supply, FIRST call bilingual_paper_editor with their exact sourcePath and reviews; it opens the same independent window before importing. Use bilingual_paper_import_files for later imports. For an already-open paper, use native MCP operations directly without opening another page or panel.

Operate the current paper through bilingual_paper_read_project and bilingual_paper_read_paragraphs. For current unsaved or failed-save author input, use bilingual_paper_read_editor_drafts; saved drafts are not live input. Never use Computer Use, browser clicks, DOM inspection, clipboard copying or a guessed window for supported paper/editor operations.

Save current author input only when I request it, using bilingual_paper_save_editor_draft with the exact capture, textHash and baseDraftRevision; never supply replacement text or a force flag. Use bilingual_paper_reconcile_translation_draft only when exact already-confirmed writeback proof permits it. Preserve input and report missing-editor, composition or version conflicts.

If this chat has an older native tool catalog, use nativeAccess.currentTransport returned by bilingual_paper_editor or bilingual_paper_get_state. Its fixed project, paragraphs, read-editor, save-editor, reconcile-draft and preparation verbs use UTF-8 JSON and inherit this same Desktop chat identity. This is MCP transport only: do not inspect plugin source, write another client, start a model worker, copy requests manually or enqueue an extra message.

For explicit whole-paper or paragraph-range translation, prepare one native translation task and continue its protected get_request/submit_translation_result loop in this same Desktop turn until completed, paused or cancelled. Follow byte-driven continuations and complete-result staging without dropping paragraphs.

Review the selected PDFs and return suggested wording, its target-language translation and reasons through approved paper tools. Source candidates require protected scope and safe compilation; source application and undo require my exact UI confirmation. Do not add unrelated model requests.
